items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I called John to me and I said, these guys are taking me to Leavenworth. I says, talk to them. So John Termin talked to them.

ctx.x: George Salsbury, the piano player there in Kansas City. And so I called John to me and I said, these guys are taking me to Leavenworth. I says, talk to them. So John Termin talked to them. He couldn't make no headway. So John said, well, yeah, you're going to have to go.

I says, well, okay. I said, well, John, I tell you what you do. Now, look, of all the things that you do tonight, get that music and take it home with you tonight and keep it. He said, well, what about the band, don't you want the band to -- he says, 'we've got all these dates, ain't no need of missing this money. I can be sending you this money while you're in the service.'
